name: Notion Mail
description: Notion Mail is Notion's Gmail-synchronized email client for organizing messages with custom views, labels, snippets, notifications, scheduling, and AI-assisted workflows. Notion has announced that the Notion Mail inbox will shut down for every plan on September 22, 2026.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Notion Mail connection or install. Use the canonical Gmail provider for supported message, label, draft, and send actions; Relay does not reuse Notion Mail's Google grant or session, manage its views or AI settings, or export and migrate its product-only data. Existing users must follow Notion's shutdown guidance and save drafts, scheduled messages, snippets, and auto-label instructions by September 21, 2026.

blocked.label: Create a Notion Mail connection
blocked.description: Notion Mail is a Gmail client whose mail authority and history remain in Google; a second Relay connection would duplicate Gmail identity, credentials, messages, and lifecycle.

blocked.label: Install duplicate mail tools
blocked.description: Relay routes supported searches, reads, labels, drafts, and sends through the canonical Gmail provider rather than mounting parallel Notion Mail tools during a published shutdown.

blocked.label: Read or change mail
blocked.description: Searching, reading, labeling, archiving, drafting, sending, scheduling, deleting, reporting, or otherwise changing Gmail messages must use the selected Gmail connection and policy.

blocked.label: Manage Notion Mail-only data
blocked.description: Views, sorting, snippets, attachments, auto-label instructions, reminders, notification preferences, and unsynced draft or scheduled-message state remain product-only data that Relay does not read, change, export, or migrate.

blocked.label: Manage AI and inbox settings
blocked.description: Notion AI labels, prompts, filters, groups, properties, signatures, snippets, notifications, scheduling, connected addresses, account deletion, and administration remain signed-in product state.

blocked.label: Automate shutdown migration
blocked.description: Relay does not sign in to export, download, copy, transform, or delete Notion Mail data; users and administrators must complete Notion's documented migration and compliance steps before the published deadlines.

blocked.label: Use private Notion Mail interfaces
blocked.description: Sessions, cookies, passwords, verification codes, browser automation, scraping, undocumented endpoints, private APIs, arbitrary Gmail access, and raw requests are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Gmail
approvalProfiles.description: No Notion Mail action is enabled because Gmail owns the message data and Notion has scheduled the client for shutdown.

runtimeSupport.description: No Notion Mail tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical Gmail provider for supported bounded email workflows.
No Notion Mail tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical Gmail provider for supported bounded email workflows.

providerSetup.blocker: Notion Mail is a two-way Gmail client, not a separate mail service or public developer platform, and Notion has announced that its inbox will shut down for all plans on September 22, 2026. Email history remains in Gmail, while drafts, scheduled emails, snippets, auto-label instructions, attachments, reminders, views, and some settings may exist only in Notion Mail and require user-led export or migration. Publishing a new provider card, Google grant, credential, installation, policy, audit identity, or runtime adapter would duplicate Gmail authority and create a new dependency on a product already in terminal shutdown.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this sunset slug non-installable and route supported mail actions to the canonical Gmail provider with its own selected connection, scopes, approval policy, audit, and disconnect lifecycle. Existing Notion Mail users must follow Notion's official shutdown instructions: export or migrate drafts, scheduled emails, snippets, auto-label instructions, and needed attachments by September 21, 2026, with regulated organizations following their earlier compliance transition. Do not automate this signed-in migration. After shutdown, retain the alias only for discovery and historical clarity unless Notion launches a materially different mail service with a stable third-party API and authorization contract.

evidence.supports: Notion states that Mail shuts down on September 22, 2026, identifies the September 21 save deadline, lists product-only data to export, confirms Gmail retains email history, and says Gmail-based agent tools continue.

Notion documents Mail as a Gmail-only client with two-way thread-level synchronization, one Gmail address per Mail account, product-specific drafts and scheduled messages, and web, macOS, and iOS clients.

Notion documents signed-in management of connected addresses, exports, views, AI labels, Gmail filters, snippets, signatures, notifications, and account deletion, including Mail-only state that can be permanently removed.

Notion documents Gmail as the only supported provider, direct Google OAuth with broad Gmail and calendar authority, two-way message and label effects, Notion-hosted mail data, and Google-admin access controls.
